about.me.1: I am a Senior Full Stack Developer specialized in Angular, with experience in NestJS, Ionic, Spring Boot, and Laravel.
about.me.2: With more than 9 years of experience, I have developed scalable and maintainable applications in enterprise environments and personal projects, working across both frontend and backend.
about.me.3: My experience focuses particularly on frontend architecture, component libraries, and reusable application development, while also contributing to the development and integration of backend services.
about.me.4: I am the creator of ddr-ng, an Angular component library focused on improving reusability, consistency, and developer experience.
about.me.5: Throughout my career, I have worked on projects across industries such as energy, manufacturing, and healthcare, while also contributing to personal projects, training, and mentoring.
accenture.bullet.1: Evolution of a component library with more than 50 components, used by more than 5 development teams to build Iberdrola's internal and corporate applications.
accenture.bullet.2: Improvement and expansion of components, focused on increasing reusability, scalability, and visual consistency across applications.
accenture.bullet.3: Standardization of the library documentation using Storybook, facilitating component adoption and usage across different teams.
accenture.bullet.4: Contributed to the development of Iberdrola's Innovation Hub, helping evolve a scalable and maintainable solution.
mainjobs.bullet.1: Delivered an intensive **Angular 20** training course to update the team's knowledge of the framework's latest features and best practices.
mainjobs.bullet.2: Covered concepts such as **Zoneless, Signals, modern templates, forms, and routing**, combining theoretical explanations with practical exercises.
mainjobs.bullet.3: Designed examples and exercises based on real-world development scenarios to facilitate the application of the concepts learned.
mainjobs.bullet.4: Helped the team adopt a more **modern, efficient, and maintainable** approach to Angular application development.
evolutio.bullet.1: Developed a post-call analysis product for call centers, enabling the extraction of relevant insights into call handling and performance.
evolutio.bullet.2: Designed and developed a reusable component library to unify styles and UI elements across different projects.
evolutio.bullet.3: Reused the component library to migrate other projects, improving visual consistency, user experience, and maintainability.
evolutio.bullet.4: Reduced development time through component reuse and the standardization of UI elements.
moontech.bullet.1: Contributed to the digitalization and optimization of industrial processes by developing solutions for factories across different industries.
moontech.bullet.2: Designed and developed an Angular component library to standardize product interfaces and reduce development time.
moontech.bullet.3: Developed a mobile application with Ionic for reading and writing NFC tags used by AGVs, enabling plant managers to modify configurations directly from mobile devices.
moontech.bullet.4: Developed and integrated complex industrial applications and systems, including multi-brand AGVs and customized production workflows, while providing technical support and knowledge sharing within the team.
indra.bullet.1: Contributed to the development and maintenance of critical healthcare applications used by public organizations such as the Madrid Health Service (SERMAS) and the Galician Health Service (SERGAS).
indra.bullet.2: Contributed to the development of a vaccination application for managing and tracking mass vaccination campaigns, particularly during the COVID-19 period.
indra.bullet.3: Contributed to the development of a telemedicine platform enabling secure communication between patients and healthcare professionals.
indra.bullet.4: Developed mobile and healthcare applications, including Madrid's Virtual Health Card and solutions for private clinics tailored to specific healthcare needs.
